name: agency-partners
label: Agency & SI Partners
description: Targets decision-makers at NetSuite Alliance Partners, Oracle NetSuite SIs, and ERP consulting firms that do commerce integrations. AOTT's Shopify capability fills the gap these agencies have when their enterprise clients need NetSuite ↔ Shopify storefronts connected. Pure Shopify agencies with no ERP context are out of scope.
_note: AOTT's value is staff augmentation for NetSuite SIs and ERP agencies: their clients run NetSuite ERP and need Shopify (or other commerce) integrations. AOTT supplies the Shopify dev capacity the SI lacks. Target: CEOs, founders, and practice leads at NetSuite Alliance Partners, Oracle consulting firms, and ERP integration shops — not pure Shopify or DTC agencies.
_company_type_signals_note: NetSuite/Oracle/ERP signals are the required primary signals. A company with only 'Shopify Agency' or 'Shopify Partner' in its name — and no ERP/NetSuite context — does NOT qualify. Shopify/Magento signals are acceptable only when paired with at least one ERP primary signal.
_target_industries_note: LinkedIn industry field alone is not sufficient — must be combined with platform-specific domain signals. Focus on companies in IT consulting and ERP/commerce implementation space.
